subject: math

objective.text: Estimate sums and differences of measurements by rounding. Then solve exactly and check that the answer is reasonable.

explanations.title: Estimate, then solve
explanations.text: First round to estimate. Then use the standard algorithm. Compare the two answers.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (round to estimate, then use the standard algorithm)

explanations.title: Is it reasonable?
explanations.text: If the exact answer is close to the estimate, it is reasonable. If it is far away, check your work.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (use estimates to assess the reasonableness of actual answers)

explanations.title: Choose how to round
explanations.text: 238 rounds to 240 by tens and 200 by hundreds. Tens gives a closer estimate here.

source_ref.section: Application Problem (Which gives a closer estimate?)

examples.title: Two water balloons
examples.text: 238 plus 238 is 476. Tens estimate: 240 plus 240 is 480. Hundreds estimate: 200 plus 200 is 400. Tens is closer.

examples.title: Rice and beans
examples.text: 58 grams and 91 grams. Estimate 60 plus 90 is 150. Exact total 149 grams. That is reasonable.

source_ref.section: Problem Set, item 1 (materials: 58 g rice, 91 g beans)

questions.text: 495 liters plus 126 liters equals what number?

source_ref.section: Fluency: Use Algorithms with Different Units (495 L + 126 L)

questions.text: Round to the nearest ten. About how much is 71 minus 23?
Each water balloon has 238 milliliters. How many milliliters are in two balloons?
Estimate two 238 milliliter balloons by rounding to tens, then to hundreds. Which estimate is closer?
Rice weighs 58 grams and beans weigh 91 grams. What is the actual total weight?
Beans weigh 91 grams and rice weighs 58 grams. Estimate the difference by rounding to the nearest ten.
Yarn A is 64 centimeters and Yarn C is 38 centimeters. What is their actual total length?

source_ref.section: Problem Set, item 2a (materials: A 64 cm, C 38 cm)

questions.text: Yarns A and C total 102 centimeters. Yarn B is 88 centimeters. What is the actual difference?
Containers hold 212, 238 and 195 milliliters. Round each to the nearest 10 and add. What is the estimate?
Containers hold 212, 238 and 195 milliliters. What is the actual total?
A movie with trailers is 115 minutes. The trailers are 5, 4, 3, 5 and 4 minutes. How long is the movie without them?
Rogelio drinks 237, 300 and 177 milliliters at three meals. How much does he drink in all?
Mr. Williams sells 367 liters of gas in the morning and 219 in the evening. How many more in the morning?
How can an estimate show that your exact answer is reasonable?

assets_required.description: A tape diagram: one long bar cut into equal units. A label shows the size of a unit or the total, and a question mark shows the unknown.
